clue.text: Arrest leads to a quarrel

definitions.meaning: to arrest a suspect is, in British police slang, to take them into custody, nick them
a heated argument or clash with someone

explanation.surface: An arrest is followed by an argument.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses of the phrase: the slang verb for taking someone into custody, and the noun for a confrontation or row.

clue.text: Listen again to Sarah before the performance proper

parts.note: to listen again is to hear a second time
Sal is a familiar short form of the name Sarah

explanation.surface: Someone plays back Sarah's audition before the actual show.
explanation.walkthrough: 'before' looks like the charade order signal, but it belongs to the definition: a practice run comes before the real show.
explanation.definitionFit: A practice run of a play or concert takes place ahead of the real show.

clue.text: No virtuous man takes alcohol as a cure

indicators.note: the pair before it takes on the drink, which follows them in the answer

parts.note: taken as written
a saint, abbreviated ST, is a supremely virtuous person
rum is a spirit, a kind of alcohol

explanation.surface: A teetotal saintly man accepts a drink as medicine.
explanation.definitionFit: A quack remedy or pet solution claimed to fix everything is a cure in name.

clue.text: Clearly he failed to express surprise at the flood

definitions.text: Clearly he failed to express surprise at the flood

parts.note: to fail to say something is to say no such thing, giving the negative word
ah is the exclamation of someone surprised

explanation.surface: The biblical patriarch was evidently unfazed when the deluge came.
explanation.walkthrough: Read as 'no ah': he gave no cry of surprise, since he had been warned and had built the ark.
explanation.definitionFit: The Genesis patriarch built the ark on God's warning, so the deluge came as no shock to him.

clue.text: Confess to having washed before going out

definitions.meaning: to own up and tell the truth about something
a playful literal reading: someone who washed would arrive spotless

explanation.surface: A person admits to having had a wash before leaving the house.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means owning up; read literally it describes someone who turns up freshly scrubbed.

clue.text: Diverse as molecules in combination

indicators.note: the letters are combined anew, like atoms joining into a compound, so they are rearranged

explanation.surface: A chemistry note: molecules combined can be of many kinds.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in combination' reads as a phrase, but 'in' is part of the fodder AS MOLECULES IN; 'combination' alone signals the rearrangement.
explanation.definitionFit: Mixed or assorted things of various kinds are varied, a synonym.

clue.text: Study computer language with available computer memory

parts.note: C is a well-known programming language
RAM, random-access memory, is the working memory a computer has available

explanation.surface: A student learns a programming language using the spare memory on a machine.
explanation.definitionFit: To revise intensively, typically before an exam, is to study hard.

clue.text: For instance absorbing a classical language is exhilarating

indicators.note: the abbreviation soaks up the language, holding it in its middle

parts.note: EG, short for exempli gratia, means for instance
Latin is the classical language of ancient Rome

explanation.surface: Learning an ancient language is said to be thrilling.
explanation.definitionFit: Something that lifts the spirits and makes one joyful is thrilling, a synonym.

clue.text: Yarn extracted from many long stockings

indicators.note: the letters are pulled out of the run of these two words

explanation.surface: Thread is taken from a lot of hosiery.
explanation.walkthrough: 'stockings' completes the picture only: the synthetic fibre is famous for hosiery.
explanation.definitionFit: A synthetic polymer spun into thread is a type of yarn.

clue.text: Look after the old man

definitions.meaning: to manage or conserve resources carefully

explanation.surface: Caring for one's elderly father.
explanation.definitionFit: As a verb it means to manage thriftily, as in conserving one's resources; as a noun it is a married partner, colloquially 'the old man'.

clue.text: He carries a letter with condition attached

definitions.text: He carries a letter with condition attached

parts.note: a dispatch is an official message or letter
a rider is a clause or condition added to a document

explanation.surface: Someone delivers mail that comes with strings attached.
explanation.walkthrough: 'with' is a link joining the two pieces; the whole clue also describes a motorcycle courier carrying messages.
explanation.definitionFit: A motorcyclist or horseman who delivers urgent messages, especially military ones, is a courier.

clue.text: The main line of defence

parts.note: the main is the sea, so this is a barrier that holds back the ocean, not a primary defensive position

explanation.surface: The chief defensive position in a battle.
explanation.definitionFit: A coastal embankment protects the land from the ocean, poetically called the main.

clue.text: Top-class railway, but not close

parts.note: A1 means first-rate, written here with I for the figure 1

explanation.surface: A first-rate rail line, though not near.
explanation.walkthrough: 'close' means stuffy, not near; 'but' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A well-ventilated room is fresh rather than stuffy or muggy.

clue.text: Sense unrest in German industrial centre

indicators.note: the word is disturbed and agitated, so its letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: One feels turmoil in a German manufacturing city.
explanation.definitionFit: A city in the Ruhr valley long known for steel and heavy industry, home of Krupp.

clue.text: No one's returned from Jerusalem

indicators.note: the whole phrase is sent back and read from end to start

parts.note: taken as written
one is I, and 's stands for is, giving I and S

explanation.surface: Nobody came back from the Holy City.
explanation.definitionFit: Zion, also spelt with S, is the hill of Jerusalem and a name for the city itself.

clue.text: To use a starting-handle is eccentric

definitions.meaning: to turn an engine over by hand with a bent handle
an odd, peculiar person with strange ideas

explanation.surface: Starting an old car by hand seems odd.
explanation.definitionFit: The verb means turning an engine by hand; the noun is a person of odd obsessions.

clue.text: Violet is clad in hat of bluish-grey

indicators.note: the short name is dressed in the headwear, which goes round it

parts.note: lid is slang for a hat
Vi is a familiar short form of the name Violet

explanation.surface: A woman named Violet wears a hat of slate colour.
explanation.definitionFit: The word originally names the leaden blue-grey of a bruise, before its sense of furious.

clue.text: Going head over heels for slim surgeon at work

indicators.note: the letters are worked over and made into something new, so they are rearranged

explanation.surface: A thin doctor tumbles about while operating.
explanation.walkthrough: 'at work' looks like one phrase, but AT belongs to the fodder SLIM SURGEON AT; 'work' alone is the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Rolling over forwards or backwards in the air or on the ground is turning head over heels.

clue.text: Bracelet comic has on is a popular craze

parts.note: a band is a ring worn round the wrist, like a bracelet
a wag is a joker or wit
on means worn, as clothes one has on

explanation.surface: A joker wears a wristband that is all the rage.
explanation.definitionFit: A fashionable movement that everyone joins, as in jumping on it, is a fad.

clue.text: Make money with stipulation that numismatists approve of it

parts.note: to mint is to strike coins
a condition is a term or stipulation in an agreement

explanation.surface: Coin collectors like being paid with strings attached.
explanation.walkthrough: 'with' is a link; numismatists are coin collectors, who prize coins in pristine, uncirculated state.
explanation.definitionFit: Coin collectors prize pieces as perfect as when they left the press, unworn and unhandled.

clue.text: French nobleman was right to be in the French Resistance

indicators.note: the letter is placed within the name of the fighters

parts.note: the Maquis were the rural guerrilla fighters of the French Resistance in WWII

explanation.surface: A French aristocrat rightly joined the wartime underground.
explanation.definitionFit: A rank of the French nobility above a count, matching the British marquess.

clue.text: Be disposed to tip

definitions.meaning: to be ... or minded to do something

explanation.surface: Feeling inclined to give a gratuity.
explanation.definitionFit: The verb means leaning towards an opinion, and also slanting or sloping physically.

clue.text: Drill for second-grade mineral

parts.note: B is the grade after A, second class
ore is mineral rock mined for metal

explanation.surface: A machine for drilling poor-quality rock.
explanation.definitionFit: To make a hole with a turning tool is to drill.

clue.text: Given a foundation arts course before taking up some French

indicators.note: the degree is placed ahead of the French word

parts.note: a BA, Bachelor of Arts, is a university arts degree

indicators.note: in a down entry the word is lifted, reading upwards, so backwards

parts.note: des is French for some

explanation.surface: A grounding came from an arts degree before learning a little French.
explanation.definitionFit: Founded or grounded on something, as a story set on fact.

clue.text: About to swindle the staff

parts.note: C is short for circa, about
to rook someone is to cheat or swindle them

explanation.surface: Defrauding the employees is roughly what happens.
explanation.walkthrough: 'staff' seems to mean employees, but it is a stick: the shepherd's hooked pole.
explanation.definitionFit: A shepherd's hooked stick is a kind of staff.

clue.text: Son is given neat boat

parts.note: neat is an old word for cattle, and a cow is one head of them

explanation.surface: A boy receives a tidy vessel.
explanation.walkthrough: 'neat' looks like tidy, but it is an old word for cattle.
explanation.definitionFit: A flat-bottomed barge for carrying cargo is a boat.

clue.text: Open ground often conceals it

indicators.note: the two words keep the letters tucked inside them

explanation.surface: Open country often hides something.
explanation.definitionFit: To unfasten a button or knot is to open it.

clue.text: Plays a part in legislation

explanation.surface: Someone has a role in making laws.
explanation.definitionFit: As a verb, performs on stage; as a plural noun, statutes passed by a legislature.

clue.text: Goad Kelly ignored

parts.note: a spur is something that goads, urges on
Ned Kelly was the famous Australian outlaw

explanation.surface: Kelly was provoked but paid no heed.
explanation.definitionFit: To reject or rebuff someone with contempt is to snub them.

clue.text: Firing and plundering

explanation.surface: Both burning and looting a town.
explanation.definitionFit: It means dismissing an employee, and also pillaging a conquered city.

clue.text: Talk about the route to Hades

indicators.note: the way leading to the underworld follows its name

parts.note: Dis is the Roman god of the underworld, and his realm, Hades
a course is a route or way

explanation.surface: A lecture on the path to the underworld.
explanation.definitionFit: A formal spoken or written treatment of a subject is talk.

clue.text: Small aquatic bird is back at sea

parts.note: a tern is a seabird

explanation.surface: A little seabird returns to the ocean.
explanation.definitionFit: On a ship, the rear part is called by its nautical name.
